name: don't take it personally, babe, it just ain't your story
source:
A spiritual successor of sorts to Digital: A Love Story, set in a prestigious private high school and on the social networks of 2027.

Seven students, three endings, one eavesdropping teacher. A full length visual novel about the erosion of privacy, young sexuality, queerness, and the perils of contemporary online life in a high school literature class.
translation:
《数字：爱情故事》的精神继承者，以一所著名的私立高中和2027年的社交网络为背景。

七个学生，三个结局，一个偷听老师。一部长篇视觉小说，讲述了高中文学课上隐私受到侵蚀、青少年性行为、酷儿行为以及当代网络生活的危险。
